    const d = u.sub(0.5).length();
    const vignette = smoothstep(float(0.78), float(0.30), d).mul(0.55).add(0.45);

    plateMats.push({ mat, cropUv, tint, vignette });
    materials.push(mat);

    const bevel = new Mesh(bevelGeo, bevelMat);
    bevel.position.z = -0.02;

      color: C_PAPER,

        p.strip.visible = true;
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        tl.to(p.group.scale, { x: 1.06, y: 1.06, z: 1.06, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out' });

        p.strip.visible = false;

    ease: 'none',

      settleTween = gsap.to(scrollState, {
        target: Math.round(scrollState.target / PITCH) * PITCH,
        duration: 0.9,
        ease: settleEase,
        delay: 0.15,
        onComplete: () => idleTl.resume(),

      timelines.push(settleTween);

  // ---------- cleanup ----------
  root.userData.cleanup = () => {
    gsap.ticker.remove(inertiaTicker);
    for (const tl of timelines) tl.kill();
    if (settleTween) settleTween.kill();
    for (const h of primHandles) h.cleanup && h.cleanup();
    for (const g of geometries) g.dispose();
    for (const m of materials) m.dispose();
    if (sharedTexture) sharedTexture.dispose();
  };

  return root;
}
